en.title: Exclusive Time of Functions
en.description:
Compute the exclusive running time of each function on a single-threaded call stack. This source explicitly points to LC636; this site adds the standard log input protocol and constraints.

The company source is still Unknown; the input protocol added by this site does not represent the I/O of the original OAMaster problem.
en.input: The first line contains the number of functions n and the number of logs m; each of the next m lines is `id:start:timestamp` or `id:end:timestamp`. Site limits: 1≤n≤100, 0≤timestamp≤10^9; logs are valid and given in chronological order.
en.output: Output n space-separated integers; item i is the exclusive execution time of function i.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for details.
hints: An end timestamp is inclusive; a start timestamp means execution begins at that moment.
